title: accept_loop / accept_loop_tls structural duplication in reader/main.rs
description:
reader/main.rs has two near-identical functions: accept_loop (plain TCP) and accept_loop_tls (NNTPS implicit TLS). The only differences are the tls_acceptor parameter type and the is_tls bool passed to run_session. All semaphore acquire, listener.accept, tokio::spawn, permit drop, and error-handling logic is verbatim copy-pasted (~40 lines each).

Suggested rewrite: one function with an implicit_tls: bool flag:

  async fn accept_loop(
      listener: TcpListener,
      semaphore: Arc<Semaphore>,
      config: Arc<Config>,
      stores: Arc<ServerStores>,
      tls_acceptor: Option<Arc<TlsAcceptor>>,
      implicit_tls: bool,
  )

NNTPS call: accept_loop(tls_listener, ..., Some(acceptor), true). Plain call: accept_loop(listener, ..., tls_acceptor, false). Backpressure, logging, and permit-drop changes only need to be made once.
